summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of TickFlow ticket management system. Backend APIs are fully functional (100% pass rate). Frontend UI and most features work correctly, but there is a critical z-index/overlay issue with the ticket drawer that blocks delete and logout button interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Drawer overlay intercepts pointer events, blocking clicks on delete confirm button and logout button when drawer is open
ui_bugs.details: The drawer's z-index or pointer-events CSS is preventing clicks on buttons. Error: 'subtree intercepts pointer events'. Users cannot delete tickets or logout when drawer is open.

passed_tests: Ticket editing (title, description, status, priority, assignee)
Status changes move tickets between columns
Export menu opens with JSON/CSV options
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical z-index/pointer-events issue in TicketDrawer component. The drawer overlay is blocking clicks on delete confirm button and logout button. Need to adjust CSS to allow clicks on buttons when drawer is open. Possible solutions: 1) Add pointer-events: none to drawer backdrop, 2) Adjust z-index values, 3) Ensure buttons have higher z-index than drawer overlay.

success_percentage.frontend: 90% (30/32 features working, 2 blocked by overlay issue)
